A GARDEN THAT LISTENS

Take the scenic route.

01 Pick an island and let the camera take you there.

02 Drag to look around. Tap the little sparkles to discover something.

A student concept inspired by the University of Bristol Botanic Garden, not a literal map or an official garden service. Discoveries are for play; you never need to leave feedback to explore. Starter spheres are playful demo content. Feedback stays in the browser used to submit it.
